## Summary

**What I did:**
- Added a new computed field to the תיק entity in `machtzev/generator/specs-ds/sechirut.txt`
- Formula: `תקרה נמוכה = min(תקרה לפי 3 חודשים, תקרה לפי שליש)`
- This computes the lower of the two ceiling values (3 months' rent vs. 1/3 of total rent)
